0x000800.en: 「At my level now...@　this is as far as I go...!」

0x000871.en: 「Ngh!@　So this is where it ends...!!」

0x0008F9.en: 「Dammit!@　You won't get me next time!」

0x000A22.en: 「Is this as far as I go...?!」

0x000B5E.en: 「Like hell I go down here...!@　This ain't fun...」

0x000BB2.en: 「I slipped up...!@　Nothing to do but bail...」

0x000C26.en: 「Ngh! No choice but to fall back!!」

0x000C9C.en: 「This is as far as I go...!」

0x000D03.en: 「This is it for me... the rest is up to you.」

0x000DAF.en: 「No good, took too many hits... I'm retreating!」

0x000DFC.en: 「Well, I'm beaten. I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x000E3A.en: 「Kyah, I'll leave the rest to you!」

0x000E81.en: 「To think the Granzon... would be shot down...」

0x000F2C.en: 「Ngh... so I'm the shooting star this time... Ejecting!」

0x001068.en: 「Nn... ngh! So this is as far as I go...!」

0x0010D5.en: 「Ngh! All hands, abandon ship at once!!」

0x00111C.en: 「I'm sorry, I leave the rest to you.」

0x001151.en: 「Damn it! Is this as far as my power goes...!」

0x00123D.en: 「Beaten in a place like this...@　I'm still not good enough...!」

0x00128B.en: 「No good, I can't take any more! Retreating!」

0x001346.en: 「Sorry, the rest is up to you!」

0x001375.en: 「N-no good! This is as far as I go!!」

0x0013B3.en: 「Well, well. So this is the end.」

0x0013E2.en: 「I can't go on. I'll be taking my leave.」

0x00146D.en: 「Careless of me...@　I'll pull back for now...!」

0x001800.en: 「So I still have far to go...!」

0x0018D5.en: 「I've no choice but to fall back...!」

0x00196A.en: 「Captain, all hands are at their stations.」

0x0019B7.en: 「For 'reserve forces,' as they modestly called us,@　they sure dropped us right in the thick of it.」

0x001A19.en: 「We already stormed Heaven's Gate once before,@　back during the Baltor incident.」

0x001A87.en: 「The situation's different now, but... it seems@　Colonel Humphrey has changed his thinking.」

0x001B11.en: 「Captain, the 1st, 2nd, and 3rd Fleets have@　begun their assault on Heaven's Gate.」

0x001B79.en: 「Now then, it's our turn to show what we can do.」

0x001BAA.en: 「Right, we go in too.@　Hold course, both engines ahead, battle speed three!」

0x001C1C.en: 「Target groups Mike, River, November,@　approaching from 12 o'clock, elevation 10!」

0x001CC2.en: 「The 2nd and 3rd Fleets have made contact too!」

0x001D0C.en: 「As planned, they've begun their assault on Heaven's Gate!」

0x001D58.en: （Let's see if ISA tactics still work in a situation@　like this... show me, Lefina Enfield.）

0x001DDB.en: 「All ships, listen up! The outcome of this battle@　will hold the key to whether Operation@　Reconquista succeeds or fails!」

0x001E6E.en: 「But don't throw your lives away here!@　Commit fully to drawing the enemy off!」

0x001EC7.en: 「Enemies from three sides...@　Judging by how they attack, the real thrust isn't among them.」

0x001F3F.en: 「High-speed object entering Area F2.@　Identified... Earth Force Hiryu Kai. Nearing Area A1.」

0x001FBC.en: 「So they've slipped in after all.@　All units, prepare to intercept!」

0x00206B.en: 「All units, launch!@　Main guns 1 through 3, prepare to fire!」

0x0020B8.en: 「Watching their homeworld's crisis unfold,@　and still they come snapping at us.@　Reckless courage, or perhaps...」

0x002142.en: 「That machine... the one in command is Roff, isn't it.」

0x002185.en: 「Right, he hated it when Shu revealed the secret of@　the Granzon too.」

0x002206.en: 「Earnest, or maybe just stiff...@　Well, he's an easy opponent for you to handle.」

0x002277.en: 「I see, so he's worth punching, then.」

0x0022B4.en: （That's not quite what 'easy to handle' means, is it...）

0x002300.en: 「Ghost 1 to all units.@　As you know, the Earth Sphere is in a precarious state.」

0x00236E.en: 「If we can't retake Heaven's Gate, Operation@　Reconquista will be badly hindered.@　Everyone, do your best.」

0x00241C.en: 「Here we come, Roff.@　I've got a big job waiting after this...@　so let me settle things quick!」

0x0024AC.en: (Such a swift advance.@ Striking one point with a specialized force...@ who'd have thought such a reckless tactic would work so well.)

0x002539.en: （It's not just that their forces excel...@　Is it the difference in what they protect, what they carry?）

0x0025BC.en: （What... what am I fighting for?@　No, such doubt is forbidden.@　I only carry out the orders I'm given...!）

0x002661.en: 「Ngh, they're good, all right...!@　But I can't hand this place over!」

0x0026F7.en: 「Heh, feeling the heat now, are ya!?」

0x0027E1.en: 「That's enough! Both of you, cease fire!」

0x00288A.en: 「H-how did you survive, in that situation!?」

0x0028D3.en: 「My rotten luck runs deep, I guess.」

0x0028F5.en: 「No, that's not the point!@　The <White Star> got swallowed up@　by the <Einst>!」

0x0029B1.en: 「The <Inspector> commander who showed up before the Guests...@　but he should've died on the <White Star>...!」

0x002A47.en: 「The details can wait.@　In any case, I've no intention of fighting you.」

0x002AD4.en: 「You did just save Roff, didn't you!」

0x002B11.en: 「He's family, more or less.@ But it's true I have no quarrel with your side.」

0x002BB9.en: 「I'll disarm.@　If you still can't trust me, shoot.@　But you've nothing to lose by hearing me out.」

0x002C56.en: 「Major Gilliam, let's hear him out.@　But don't drop your guard.」

0x002CFF.en: 「Roff... I came here on special orders from the Privy Council.」

0x002D79.en: 「To put an end to Zezernan's private war.」

0x002DC3.en: 「The Council has caught on to his true motives.@　The evidence is all in, and an order recalling him home has been issued.」

0x002E53.en: 「Failing to stop Shu Shirakawa was fatal.@ Zezernan's downfall is certain now.@ How long do you mean to keep obeying a man like that?」

0x002F50.en: 「A mercenary, huh... A man like you could've had@　a general's seat without lifting a finger.」

0x002FB2.en: 「Even so, that wouldn't be something I've earned through my own strength.@　A rank won by birthright means nothing.」

0x003038.en: 「So that's why you cast off your house and became a mercenary.」

0x003072.en: 「...I never liked that suffocating world where bloodline alone decides your whole life.@ That's why I fight out here on the frontier.」

0x003132.en: 「Then all the more reason not to stand with Zezernan.@ That man is the very symbol of what's wrong with the nobility.」

0x0031A9.en: 「It was none other than him who dragged the feud@　between the Zogal and Wolga factions all the way@　to Earth, a non-member world.」

0x00323F.en: 「But there's a just cause behind it: auditing Earth's@　immature civilization to keep the galaxy's order.」

0x0032B9.en: 「Yeah... I used to think that too.@ But it was because Zezernan moved first that Wolga@ sent me and Wendro out in the first place.」

0x003370.en: 「We had the noble cause of preserving galactic order,@　but in the end we were just used for the faction's gain...」

0x0033FF.en: 「That's right, we're in no place to laugh at the Earthlings.@　The scale's different, sure, but squabbling among@　our own is one and the same.」

0x0034AA.en: 「And by fighting the Earthlings head-on, I learned@ they're not the immature race Wendro and@ Zezernan claimed they were.」

0x003561.en: 「You've noticed it too, haven't you?@ Zezernan is using this war for his own ambitions.」

0x0035E8.en: 「The whole reason he took you in was to use the@　Delfarte name later on, no doubt.」

0x003678.en: 「Listen, Roff.@　Is this really what you wanted to do?@　To be nothing but a tool that moves on command?」

0x003723.en: 「...You're right, I'll admit it.@　I've been unable to find any meaning in this war...」

0x00379D.en: 「But I can't make peace with it as neatly as you.」

0x0037E6.en: 「Then what do you mean to do?」

0x00380B.en: 「Give me time. There's something I want to see for myself.」

0x003854.en: 「If you go back to Zezernan,@ it may not end well for you, you know?」

0x0038B0.en: 「I'm aware.@　But Seti and Zeb are under that man's command.」

0x003909.en: 「...All right.@　But the command of the bioroids here is mine to hold,@　in the name of the Privy Council.」

0x0039A6.en: 「Like hell we're letting him get away!!」

0x0039CB.en: 「Wait.@　For my sake, let him go this once.」

0x003A21.en: 「What're you saying!?@　A slap across your face won't come close to settling this!」

0x003A86.en: 「...I told you I've no wish to fight you.@　Now I'll show you the proof.」

0x003AEE.en: 「Captain, the enemy units in the combat zone are@　shutting down one after another!」

0x003B4E.en: 「What about the units fighting the other fleets?」

0x003B95.en: 「...Every Zogal machine in this sector will@　cease fighting before long.@　I'd like you to trust me now.」

0x003C3A.en: 「So, what do you intend to do?」

0x003C68.en: 「I want to talk with you all directly.@　Though I don't expect a warm welcome.」

0x003CED.en: 「......Very well. Permission to land is granted.」

0x003D2D.en: 「The Earth's in mortal danger, and yet@　here you come waltzing in!」

0x003D8C.en: 「Backs to the wall, that's us!@　Don't think you can stop us now!」

0x003E47.en: 「For one thing, the fact you're alive at all@　is a mystery. Escaping that situation......」

0x003EC4.en: 「Told you my rotten luck runs deep, didn't I?@　Though I was near dead... most of my body's@　been swapped out for replacements now.」

0x003F82.en: 「Well, you can think of it that way.」

0x003FB6.en: 「So then, what you told Roff earlier...@　is it the truth?」

0x004006.en: 「Yeah. I was sent to Earth's sphere as an envoy@　of the Zovorc Privy Council, to stop Zezernan.」

0x00408F.en: 「Zovorc... is that the name of your nation?」

0x0040D5.en: 「That's right. And within it are two great factions...@　the ones you call the Inspectors are the Wolga,@　and the Guests are called the Zogal.」

0x004198.en: 「The Wolga and the Zogal are locked in a@　power struggle inside Zovorc. And that mess@　got dragged into the Earth sphere.」

0x004246.en: 「What a pain in the neck, honestly.」

0x00426E.en: 「Anyway, I've come under orders from the@　Zovorc Privy Council to end the war with Earth.@　Later I'll deliver Zezernan a recall order.」

0x004356.en: 「I'd like to hope so......@　In any case, it'd help if you'd put me up@　under your roof for a while.」

0x0043DA.en: 「Of course, I'm prepared for strict surveillance.@　Think of me as a hostage, if you like.」

0x00446C.en: 「......Understood.@　We'll take you into our custody.」
